notes.title: Hotshot Racing Update Now Live
notes.notes:
Since Hotshot Racing's launch back in September, we've been blown away by the love and support our retro racer has received. It's been incredible to see all the lightning-fast laps, photo finishes and explosive scrapes from all our hard-drivin' Hotshots.
 
We're pleased to reveal Hotshot Racing has been installed more than 500K times across all platforms! Check out some other interesting Hotshot tidbits below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36924418/3e8e6349dc4f9679452587b30448339819c31018.gif

We've also been listening closely to all of your feedback and are pleased to announce our first Hotshot Racing update, which tackles many of the common issues you've been sharing on Twitter, Discord and Steam.

 Achievement unlocks: Players can now unlock the 'Overachiever'  and 'Trophy Hunter' achievements

 Quick/Ranked Race fixes: Resolved the issue where players were unable to start a race

 Speed glitch resolved: We have increased car speed across Normal, Hard and Expert modes! Jump into Time Trial and set new records with upgraded performance

 Controller fixes: Game will now prioritise your game pad over other control options; Xbox 360 controller support has also been improved

And we're still listening! Feel free to share you feedback on these updates, or any other issues you're having:

 In our Steam forums
 On our Discord server
 By commenting below!

We hope these updates give you an even better Hotshot experience. Have these fixes improved the game for you? If so, please leave a review or rating on Steam, Xbox or PlayStation Store.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/609920/Hotshot_Racing/

notes.title: Hotshot Racing gets a release date
notes.notes: Hotshot Racing finally has a release date and it's only a few short days away, with the 90s-styled arcade racer from Lucky Mountain Games and Sumo Digital hitting PC, Switch, Xbox One and PlayStation 4 on September 10th. It marks the end of almost a decade long journey for what was once known as Racing Apex, with the title changing as arcade racing experts Sumo Digital came onboard to help out. It's a fairly expansive thing, with multiplayer for four players in local splitscreen or for eight players online, and with a suite of game modes - oh, and it's 60fps on all platforms (though I'm not sure if that's across all modes). We'll have a review up for you a couple of days before Hotshot Racing comes out early next month. Read more
